The '''Kelari Lily''' was a rare [[Flower/Legends|Flower]] that could be used to treat battlefield injuries.<ref name="Arda" />

==History==
[[Lorren Morrick]] sent a rebel patrol out to find Kelari Lilies because her medical supplies were running short.<ref name="Arda" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'' {{1st}}
